title: Thailand Island Paradise (Phuket, Krabi & Bangkok)
hotel_name: Phuket Grace Beach Resort & Sukhumvit Bangkok Luxury Hotel
description: Experience tropical island heaven in Thailand. Island hop across Phi Phi Islands on a speedboat, marvel at Maya Bay where 'The Beach' was filmed, explore James Bond Island in Phang Nga Bay, and enjoy Bangkok's vibrant shopping & temple architecture.
highlights: Full Day Phi Phi Island Speedboat Tour with Snorkeling & Lunch
Phang Nga Bay & James Bond Island Sea Canoeing Tour
Phuket Fantasea Cultural Show & Patong Beach Nightlife Walk
Bangkok City Temple Tour (Wat Pho Golden Reclining Buddha)
Chaophraya Princess Luxury Dinner Cruise in Bangkok

included_services.meals: Daily Buffet Breakfast & 2 Speedboat Island Buffet Lunches
included_services.transport: Private AC Airport & Island Speedboat Transfers
included_services.activities: Phi Phi Speedboat Ticket, National Park Entry, Cruise Ticket

excluded_services: Thailand Visa Fees (Visa-Free / Visa on Arrival)

itinerary.title: Phuket Arrival & Patong Beach Night Walk
itinerary.description: Arrive at Phuket International Airport (HKT). Private transfer to beachfront resort. Evening walk at Bangla Road Patong for vibrant nightlife and Thai street food.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Islands Speedboat Tour & Maya Bay
itinerary.description: Board luxury speedboat to Phi Phi Islands. Swim at Pileh Lagoon, snorkel at Coral Bay, visit Monkey Beach, and step onto iconic Maya Bay. Buffet lunch served on Phi Phi Don.

itinerary.title: Phang Nga Bay & James Bond Island Sea Canoeing
itinerary.description: Explore Phang Nga Bay limestone cliffs. Sea canoeing through Hong Island sea caves and visit James Bond Island (Khao Phing Kan).

itinerary.title: Flight to Bangkok & Chaophraya Dinner Cruise
itinerary.description: Fly to Bangkok. Check-in to Sukhumvit city hotel. Evening luxury dinner cruise along Chaophraya River passing illuminated Grand Palace and Wat Arun.

itinerary.title: Bangkok Temples & MBK Center Shopping
itinerary.description: Guided temple tour visiting Wat Pho (Reclining Buddha) and Wat Traimit (Golden Buddha). Afternoon shopping at Siam Paragon and MBK Shopping Center.

itinerary.title: Bangkok Airport Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel. Private transfer to Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) for flight home.

cancellation_policy: Full refund 14 days prior to departure. 50% refund 7 days prior.
travel_tips: Thai Baht cash is recommended for local night markets
Dress modestly (shoulders & knees covered) when visiting Bangkok temples

faqs.question: Is Indian food available in Thailand?
faqs.answer: Yes, Sukhumvit in Bangkok and Patong in Phuket feature hundreds of authentic Indian restaurants.
